items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-08-30
items.q: I understand that Villa Kersan made her live to give him a $500 go or a diamond ring.

ctx.x: Well, I think something like that belongs in the university because that's history from 75 years ago.

Oh, it's more than that. I guess 80 years. That's all it's sung. There's a time that Villa Kersan went to Langland and made Queen Victoria live. And then you have queens and kings don't live. But I understand that Villa Kersan made her live to give him a $500 go or a diamond ring. I saw Villa Kersan. The greatest minister man ever after the Negro race, after the Civil War. And he made a hit with that song. And I'll never forget it. And I'll write it. And if I had a thought about it, if I had it written here, my…
Well, how did he make Queen Victoria laugh?
